content.user_title: Create and Edit Lark Slides Presentations
content.value_statement: Creating polished Lark Slides from an AI assistant can be slow and error prone. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through planning, XML generation, editing, media upload, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Creates new Lark Slides presentations with one-step or two-step XML workflows.
Reads presentations and individual slide XML for review or follow-up edits.
Adds, deletes, replaces, and inserts slide pages or slide blocks.
Uploads local images to a Lark Slides presentation and uses returned file tokens.
Guides slide planning, visual layout choices, and post-create validation checks.
Provides IconPark lookup and XML lint helpers for slide quality checks.
limitations: Requires lark-cli, valid Lark authentication, and the required document permissions.
Cannot bypass Lark API limits, media size limits, or workspace access controls.
Visual screenshot validation depends on Lark screenshot API availability.
Image paths must stay inside the current working directory for upload workflows.

use_cases.title: Build a project update deck
use_cases.description: Turn an outline, audience, and key metrics into a planned Lark Slides presentation with clear page roles.

use_cases.title: Refresh an existing presentation
use_cases.description: Update titles, visuals, images, or whole pages while preserving the original Lark Slides link.

use_cases.title: Generate technical explainer slides
use_cases.description: Create XML-based diagrams, charts, and structured slide layouts for architecture or process explanations.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new presentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 5-slide Lark Slides deck about [topic] for [audience]. Use a concise business style and include one visual idea per slide.

prompt_templates.title: Edit One Existing Slide
prompt_templates.prompt: Update slide [slide id or page number] in this Lark Slides presentation: [link]. Replace the title with [title] and keep the layout stable.

prompt_templates.title: Rebuild Multiple Pages
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a larger edit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite pages [range] in this Lark Slides presentation: [link]. Preserve the existing link, improve visual structure, and verify the result.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Visual Technical Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with diagrams and validation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a technical Lark Slides deck about [system]. Include an architecture page, process flow, comparison page, image plan, and final validation record.

output_examples.input: Create a 6-slide quarterly review for product leadership.
output_examples.output: A Lark Slides presentation with a cover, KPI overview, timeline, risks, next steps, and a validation note.

output_examples.input: Update page 3 of an existing presentation with a new chart image.
output_examples.output: The same presentation link with page 3 updated, the image inserted as a Lark file token, and surrounding content preserved.

output_examples.input: Turn this architecture explanation into slides for engineers.
output_examples.output: A structured deck with an architecture diagram, concise labels, supporting notes, and checks for page count and layout risks.

best_practices: Confirm the audience, page count, and desired style before generating a new deck.
Use the planning layer for new decks or major rewrites before creating XML.
Read back the presentation after edits and verify page count, key content, and layout risks.
anti_patterns: Do not paste external image URLs directly into slide XML.
Do not rebuild an entire presentation when a block-level edit is enough.
Do not skip validation after creating or replacing multiple slides.

faq.question: Does this skill create new Lark Slides presentations?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports blank presentations and presentations created from XML slide content.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing Lark Slides link?
faq.answer: Yes. It can read existing slides and replace pages or individual blocks while keeping the same link.

faq.question: Does it need Lark authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The user or bot must be authenticated with lark-cli and have the required permissions.

faq.question: Can it use images in slides?
faq.answer: Yes. Local images can be uploaded to the target presentation and used through returned file tokens.

faq.question: Can it verify the final deck visually?
faq.answer: It can read back XML and run structural checks. Full visual screenshot checks depend on Lark API availability.

faq.question: Is it only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
